tested_scope.policy: accept only exact strings matching ^[0-9a-f]{64}$; no trimming or normalization

positive_evidence_scope: synthetic deterministic two-record reconstruction with one trailing-U+0009 otherwise-valid lowercase-64-hex digest, one exact lowercase-64-hex sibling, no normalization or trimming, and exactly two arrival permutations

mechanism_assessment.observation: The trailing-U+0009 candidate has length 65 and does not satisfy the exact ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ identity rule. It is rejected before parent aggregation in both precommitted arrival orders. In the valid-first order, the one staged valid sibling is cleared when the malformed candidate arrives, leaving no partial parent aggregate.
mechanism_assessment.inference: For this exact synthetic boundary, forbidding trimming makes reconstruction deterministic and fail-closed across both tested arrival permutations and prevents a tab-suffixed digest from aliasing to a canonical digest identity.
mechanism_assessment.unverified: Trailing LF/CR, other ASCII or non-ASCII whitespace, multiple whitespace code points, uppercase or 0x-prefixed digests, more than two records, multiple malformed digests, concurrent parent generations, crash between staging and malformed arrival, durable rollback semantics, digest collisions, and interoperability with producers that intentionally emit whitespace-padded digests remain untested.
